BJP Accuses Rahul Gandhi of Defaming India Abroad

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leaders have accused Congress leader Rahul Gandhi of insulting and defaming India while speaking abroad. BJP leader Gaurav Bhatia called Gandhi "Mir Jafar of India" and alleged he was trying to tarnish the country's image. Other BJP leaders, including Nitin Nabin and Prahlad Joshi, echoed these sentiments, stating Gandhi was criticizing India after failing to gain trust domestically. These accusations follow Gandhi's remarks during his US visit, where he reportedly warned of economic disaster in India, a statement that has drawn criticism from the BJP, which simultaneously highlights India's strong economic growth.
